notes.title: Content Patch #10 -- Balance and Quality of Life
notes.content:
The game has been patched to add new symbols, items, features, and bug fixes!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new symbols (1 Common, 1 Uncommon, 1 Rare)
[*] Added 2 new items (1 Uncommon, 1 Essence)
[*] Modified 5 existing symbols (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Modified 37 existing items (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Removed 1 existing symbol (changes listed under Game Balance)
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Sliders that can change various in-game colors (available under the Graphics Options)
[*] Added a setting for Counting Speed (1x by default)
[*] Added a setting for Scientific Notation (enabled by default)
[*] Added a setting for Digit Separators (enabled by default)
[*] Added settings that can decrease the game speed (0.75x and 0.5x)
[*] Added 15 tips that can appear after from the 5th Rent Payment onward if Floor 2 is unlocked
[*] Added titles to the reminder texts of Removal Tokens, Reroll Tokens, and Essences Tokens
[*] Made the Animation Speed also apply to the Email Pop-ups
[*] Improved positioning and sizing of reminder texts on symbols
[*] Replaced decimal points with decimal commas if the language is set to French, Italian, German, Spain-Spanish, LatAm-Spanish, Brazilian-Portuguese, Danish, Russian, or Polish
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Items can now have their effects toggled by hovering over them and pressing the Enable/Disable Item hotkey (Right Mouse Button by default)
[*] Items can now re-appear in the "item pool" after being destroyed
[*] Adoption Papers Essence now gives 33 coins when destroyed (instead of 50 coins)
[*] Ancient Lizard Blade Essence now gives 40 coins and gives 8 coins less for each symbol in the inventory with a quantity of 2 or more (instead of 80 coins and 10 coins less)
[*] Anthropology Degree is now Rare (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Anthropology Degree Essence now gives a permanent multiplier of 1.5x when destroyed (instead of 2x)
[*] Big Symbol Bomb Essence now gives 2 Removal Tokens when destroyed (instead of 4 Removal Tokens)
[*] Booster Pack Essence now destroys itself after 12 spins (instead of 0 spins)
[*] Capsule Machine is now Rare (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Cardboard Box now gives a Removal Token every 9 spins (instead of every 6 spins)
[*] Checkered Flag Essence now destroys itself after 7 triggers (instead of 5 triggers)
[*] Chicken Coop Essence now gives a permanent bonus of 4 coins when destroyed (instead of 3 coins)
[*] Compost Heap Essence now adds 2 Watermelons when destroyed (instead of 3 Watermelons)
[*] Copycat Essence now destroys itself when 5 Cats are adjacent (instead of 4 Cats)
[*] Cyan Pepper has had its description reworded to increase clarity (this doesn't change its effect)
[*] Cyan Pepper Essence has had its description reworded to increase clarity (this doesn't change its effect)
[*] Dishwasher now gives an Essence Token every 12 spins (instead of every 9 spins)
[*] Dogs now have the additional effect of giving 1 additional coin if adjacent to at least 1 non-Billionaire Human symbol
[*] Dwarven Anvil Essence now gives a permanent multiplier of 1.5x when destroyed (instead of 2x)
[*] Essence Capsules now have a base value of -12 coins (instead of 0 coins)
[*] Frozen Pizza Essence now destroys itself after 5 triggers (instead of 10 triggers)
[*] Frying Pan Essence now gives a permanent multiplier of 3x when destroyed (instead of 2x)
[*] Golden Carrot Essence now destroys itself after 7 spins (instead of 0 spins) and makes 1 symbol Very Rare (instead of 2 symbols)
[*] Goldilocks has been reworked to have the effect "You may destroy this item and add 3 Bears." (instead of her previous effect)
[*] Hooligans now have a base value of 2 coins (instead of 1 coin)
[*] Instant Ramen Essence now adds 2 items when destroyed (instead of 3 items)
[*] Jack-o'-lantern Essence now gives a permanent multiplier of 1.5x when destroyed (instead of 2x)
[*] Kyle the Kernite Essence now destroys itself if there are at least 3 Shiny Pebbles and Ores (instead of 5)
[*] Lucky Carrot Essence now destroys itself after 15 spins (instead of 0 spins)
[*] Lunchbox Essence now gives 33 coins when destroyed (instead of 50 coins)
[*] Maxwell the Bear Essence now gives a permanent multiplier of 1.5x when destroyed (instead of 2x)
[*] Miners now give 15 coins for each Ore and Big Ore destroyed (instead of 10 coins)
[*] Mines now have a base value of 4 coins (instead of 1 coin)
[*] Nori the Rabbit Essence now gives a permanent multiplier of 1.5x when destroyed (instead of 2x) and destroys itself if there are at least 4 Rabbits and Rabbit Fluffs (instead of 3)
[*] Piggy Bank now gives 2.5x the coins inside it when destroyed (instead of 2x the coins inside it)
[*] Plum has been removed from the game
[*] Protractor Essence now destroys itself after 4 spins (instead of 6 spins)
[*] Recycling is now Very Rare (instead of Rare)
[*] Recycling Essence now gives 5 Reroll Tokens (instead of 8 Reroll Tokens)
[*] Small Symbol Bomb Essence now gives 1 Removal Token when destroyed (instead of 2 Removal Tokens)
[*] Swear Jar Essence now gives 40 coins if a spin's total is 20 coins or less (instead of giving 50 coins if a spin's total is 15 coins or less)
[*] Telescope Essence now destroys itself after 3 spins (instead of 4 spins)
[*] Time Machine Essence now destroys itself after 2 triggers (instead of 3 triggers)
[*] Very Big Symbol Bomb Essence now gives 4 Removal Tokens when destroyed (instead of 8 Removal Tokens)
[*] Zaroff's Contract Essence now gives 50 coins when destroyed (instead of 77 coins)
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

[b]Preamble:[/b]

While the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404850/view/5510701238793103299]previous Content Patch[/url] was very well received by many players, the introduction of Essences led to many feeling the game was "too easy." It's very difficult to achieve balance that makes the majority of players happy, but I think I was able to re-balance many of the Essences in a way that would satisfy players seeking more difficulty (while not alienating players who enjoy an easier gameplay experience).

A lot of the Essences were nerfed in ways that may seem slightly "un-fun" on the surface, but I hope that many of you can see that the added challenge of trying to optimize and min-max a game of Luck be a Landlord is important to the health of the game. The main goal was to keep Essences as sometimes "build-defining" but reduce the amount of times Essences were "build-winning."

I extensively tested the game on Floor 15, and I feel the (maximum) difficulty level has been brought to a place that should be fun for players seeking a challenge. The other 14 Floors are also always available for players seeking an easier experience.

I'm also looking into revamping the Apartment Floor system, in order to make some of the added difficulty feel less artificial.

[b]Moving on to the individual changes...[/b]

Item Disabling was mostly added as a quality-of-life feature rather than as a balance feature, as it's not likely to be very relevant in pre-Endless mode. There may still be some situations where you want to disable an item before Endless Mode though, keep an eye out!

Items re-appearing after being destroyed is also mostly to add a bit more Endless mode variety, as the likelihood of the same item appearing twice in pre-Endless mode is relatively unlikely. Not impossible though!

Adoption Papers Essence, Ancient Lizard Blade Essence, Lunchbox Essence, and Zaroff's Contract Essence had their coin values reduced as their effect was relatively easy to obtain compared to how many coins were given.

Anthropology Degree is now Rare instead of Uncommon as there are now enough Human symbols in the game to increase its power level to that of a Rare (there were only 19 Human symbols when the item was initially added to the game, as opposed to the 25 that are in the game now)

Anthropology Degree Essence had its Permanent Multiplier reduced as the effect was frequently more than game-winning when triggered, and finding 9 worthwhile Human symbols was easier to do than initially anticipated.

The Symbol Bomb Essences have had their Removal Tokens halved as the amount of Removal Tokens they previously granted was more than enough to greatly sway the outcome of a game.

Booster Pack Essence, Golden Carrot Essence, and Lucky Carrot Essence now have "spin timers" before their effects trigger in order to reduce their power level, as their effects being immediate led to them being some of the most powerful Essences in the game. I'm still keeping an eye on reducing their power levels further if necessary.

Capsule Machine is now Rare instead of Uncommon as there are now enough Capsule symbols in the game to increase its power level to that of a Rare (there were only 5 Capsule symbols when the item was initially added to the game, as opposed to the 10 that are in the game now)

Carboard Box and Dishwasher had their "spin timer" values increased as their effects were happening frequently enough that the game could be drastically shifted soon after one of the items was obtained. This should help bring the items to a more baseline power level, while still keeping them fun to use.

Checkered Flag Essence was buffed in order to slightly increase the power level of the Essence as it could be lacking when compared to many of the other Essences. A notable exception is when the player has this item and Robin Hood, but that combo shouldn't come up too frequently.

Chicken Coop Essence and Frying Pan Essence had their Bonuses increased as their effect were very difficult to obtain, so this should make achieving them more rewarding when one can pull it off.

Compost Heap Essence's effect could be easily triggered at many stages of the game, so the amount of Watermelons added from it has been reduced in order to reduce its power level.

Copycat Essence's effect was almost always game-winning when triggered, but could be obtained too easily. For this reason, the amount of adjacent Cats needed for the effect was increased by 1, in order to reduce the amount of "auto-pilot" runs obtainable early in the game. The resulting effect was retained, however, as it can be very fun to play with once it's achieved.

Dogs were only really ever useful if the player had Quigley the Wolf, so adding a new effect to them should increase their early-game viability.

Dwarven Anvil Essence, Jack-o'-lantern Essence, and Maxwell the Bear Essence had their Permanent Multipliers reduced as their effects were too easy to trigger when compared to the long-term benefits that were granted.

Essence Capsules had their base value greatly reduced as they were far too powerful and game-changing for, effectively, no risk to the player. Adding a detriment will make players have to think a bit more as to whether they can take an Essence Capsule. I'm keeping an eye on alternative solutions and tweaks to the symbol, if necessary.

Frozen Pizza Essence's effect was far too powerful when compared to how many extra symbols could be seen (and potentially added). For this reason, its "trigger value" was halved.

Goldilocks has been reworked as her previous effect was nearly impossible to trigger, and for very little reward. The updated effect still fits with the theme of the item, and also combos nicely with her Essence counterpart. I'm currently exploring solutions to rework Flush as well, as it has similar problems to pre-rework Goldilocks.

Hooligans were buffed as they were almost always outclassed by the Grave Robber item. This value increase should make Hooligans feel like less of a detriment when kept around for many spins.

Instant Ramen Essence was extremely powerful when compared to many of the other Essences, so the amount of items one can add after skipping an item was reduced by 1.

Kyle the Kernite Essence was buffed as its previous effect could be very difficult to obtain, even with a destroyed Golem. This should help increase the viability of the Essence.

Miners were buffed as the amount of coins they granted for destroyed symbols was almost never enough to get one past the "mid-game." This was especially true when combined with the low value symbols that the destroyed Ores and Big Ores would add to the player's inventory.

Mines were buffed in order to slightly increase their power level when compared to Golems, their Uncommon counterpart.

Nori the Rabbit Essence had its Permanent Multiplier reduced as its effect was too easy to trigger when compared to the long-term benefits that could be obtained. The amount of Rabbits and Rabbit Fluffs needed to trigger the Essence was also increased to make players have to commit a bit more to a "Rabbit build" if they wanted to benefit from the Permanent Multiplier.

Piggy Bank was buffed in order to increase the item's "game-saving" potential, as well as making it not just a strictly-worse Horseshoe.

Plum was removed from the game as its effect was identical to Peach, and didn't make the game more fun or intriguing in any way.

Protractor Essence and Telescope Essence had their "spin timers" reduced as their effects could guarantee a win in most situations.

Recycling had its rarity increased as the effect, while very fun and powerful, was appearing too frequently. The item being Very Rare instead of Rare should make it feel more special when one gets to benefit from the large amount of Reroll Tokens gained.

Recycling Essence had its Reroll Tokens reduced to bring the item in line with other Essences' power levels.

Swear Jar's effect was extremely difficult to trigger, so the Essence had its values changed to make the effect easier to obtain.

Time Machine Essence's effect could be easily triggered at many stages of the game, so the amount of triggers has been reduced in order to reduce its power level.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

notes.title: Content Patch #9 -- Hotfix #13
notes.content:
The game has been patched to re-balance a few Essences and add a new Korean localization.

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Korean localization
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added editable color hex codes to LBAL-Settings.save that allow players to change a few of the in-game colors (a UI to edit these colors is planned for a later patch, but I wanted to partially add this feature so that users who were experiencing discomfort from the bright colors of the game could modify them immediately) [spoiler]The color hex codes will currently only take effect if modified while the game is closed[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Booster Pack Essence no longer adds Rare symbols (it still adds Uncommon and Very Rare symbols)
[*] Cardboard Box Essence now gives 3 Removal Tokens after 12 spins (instead of 6 Removal Tokens)
[*] Conveyor Belt Essence now makes symbols 2x more likely to add symbols (instead of 3x)
[*] Copycat Essence now requires 4 adjacent Cats to trigger (instead of 3 adjacent Cats) and makes Cats give 1.5x more coins (instead of 2x more coins, they also still become Wildcards)
[*] Cursed Katana Essence now makes NInjas give 3 more coins (instead of 2 more coins)
[*] Dwarven Anvil Essence now makes Dwarves give 2x more coins (instead of 2.5x more coins)
[*] Golden Carrot Essence now makes 2 symbols guaranteed to be Very Rare (instead of 3 symbols)
[*] Jack-o'-Lantern Essence now makes Toddlers give 2x more coins (instead of 2.5x more coins)
[*] Lemon Essence now destroys itself if there are 4 or more Empty symbols (instead of 3 or more) and makes Empty symbols give 4 more coins (instead of 3 more coins)
[*] Oil Can Essence now destroys itself after 7 re-spins (instead of 5 re-spins)
[*] Oswald the Monkey Essence now makes Monkeys give 1.5x more coins (instead of 2x more coins)
[*] Recycling Essence now gives 8 Recycling Tokens (instead of 10 Recycling Tokens)
[*] Rusty Gear Essence now makes symbols give 1.5 more coins (instead of 2x more coins)
[*] Shattered Mirror Essence now gives 77 coins (instead of 100 coins)
[*] Sunglasses Essence now gives 5 Removal Tokens (instead of 6 Removal Tokens)
[*] Swapping Device Essence now destroys itself after 7 swaps (instead of 5 swaps)
[*] Tax Evasion Essence now makes symbols give 25 more coins (instead of 20 more coins)
[*] Triple Coins Essence now makes Coins give 2 more coins (instead of 3 more coins)
[*] Undertaker Essence now makes Spirits give 2 more coins (instead of 1 more coin)
[*] Watering Can Essence now makes Seeds give 25 more coins (instead of 10 more coins)
[/list]

The above balance changes were all made for the same reason:

When essences were initially added, I was a bit too extreme with the power-level of some of them. While I do want essences to make the game easier at lower floors, having some essences be "auto-wins" even on floor 15 was definitely not my intention.

For this reason, several of the more powerful essences have had their power level reduced, and a few less powerful essences have been buffed. The essences I chose to reduce the power level of were ones that could be incredibly powerful if found at early stages of the game.

I would also like to address the folks who have stated that "essences are too powerful." While I don't disagree with you in some instances (hence the balance changes), please keep in mind that the vast majority of "broken" essences aren't intended to truly shine until Endless mode. Many of the screenshots being sent to me with very high coin counts are in endless mode on rent payment #30 or higher.

If a player can "break" endless mode with the help of essences, this is actually a good thing. You've already "beaten" the game if you're in endless mode, so anything after that point is just a bonus. On that note, essences that can carry a player to endless mode as early as rent payment #4 was definitely not my intention when adding essences to the game.

Lastly, these changes are obviously not perfect, and I'm still keeping a close eye on essences to keep tweaking their power level if need be.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

notes.title: Content Patch #9 -- Essences
notes.content:
The game has been patched to add new content, features, and bug fixes!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new currency (Essence Tokens)
[*] Added 1 new symbol (1 Uncommon)
[*] Added [b]110 new items[/b] (1 Common, 1 Rare, 1 Very Rare, 107 Essence)
[*] Added 6 new apartment floors
[*] Added 4 new landlord fates
[*] Modified 2 existing symbols (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Simplified Chinese localization
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's French localization
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Russian localization
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Italian localization
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Japanese localization
[*] Added internal stat-tracking for wins, losses, winstreaks, etc. (a menu that displays these stats in-game will be implemented in a later patch)
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[*] Made the "item count" text on Items a different color (to differentiate from items that also have "value reminder" text)
[*] Made the Confirm/Select hotkey activate the "Pay Rent" button even if rent-relevant items (such as Swear Jar or Piggy Bank) are displayed
[*] Made the Inventory hotkey close the inventory if pressed on screens other than the "new email" screen
[*] Made Items' reminder texts count down instead of up (they still function the same way, this is mostly to make them consistent Symbols' reminder texts)
[/list]

[h1]News[/h1]

Oh man! This has been a long time coming!

For those of you who didn't read the patch notes for Content Patch #8, I mentioned that the new mode I had been designing/developing for several months had "morphed" into something "very different, but very cool." The "very different, but very cool" thing appears in this Content Patch! I'm referring to "Essences."

Essences are effectively alternative versions of existing items that follow a few different rules:

1. They don't have a rarity associated with them, all Essences have an equal chance of appearing if they're not already in your inventory.
2. They do not appear in the regular "Item pool."
3. They have different effects from their non-Essence counterparts.
4. They are obtained after your landlord steals your "Essence Tokens" (you add one Essence per token stolen)
5. They are somewhat more complicated than regular items, so they have to be unlocked...

There are three ways to unlock the Essences and have them appear in your game:

1. Win a game on Floor 6 (this applies retroactively to older savefiles and does not have to be done multiple times)
2. Win 7 games of Luck be a Landlord (unfortunately, this stat was not tracked until this Patch, so your previous wins don't count towards unlocking Essences, sorry about that!)
3. If you're in the camp of having played many games of Luck be a Landlord, but weren't interested in the higher Apartment Floors, I would recommend editing your savefile if you want to play with Essences immediately (in order to unlock Essences by editing your savefile, do the following: [spoiler]
1. Launch the game at least once after updating to Content Patch #9
2. Close the game
3. Open your LBAL-Stats.save file at one of the following locations with a text editor:
Windows: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Roaming/Godot/app_userdata/Luck be a Landlord/LBAL-Stats.save
macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Luck be a Landlord/LBAL-Stats.save
Linux: ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Luck be a Landlord/LBAL-Stats.save
4. Change the following line that reads [b]"essences_unlocked":false[/b] to instead read [b]"essences_unlocked":true[/b]
5. Save and close the LBAL-Stats.save file
6. Launch the game, and Essences will be unlocked!
[/spoiler])

There are more than 100 Essence items, each with a unique effect! I hope you enjoy playing with them as much as I enjoyed designing and implementing them.

In other news, the Luck be a Landlord soundtrack is available on [url=https://vincentcolavita.bandcamp.com/album/luck-be-a-landlord-official-video-game-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url]! The Music Team (which is really just Vincent Colavita) decided to add a new remix of an existing track every other Content Patch. If you've already purchased the soundtrack, these remixes will be automatically added to your library.

I've also been able to fill out the last remaining positions of the Localization Team, which has led to the game being re-localized in Simplified Chinese, French, Russian, Italian, and Japanese. To those of you who play in those languages, I hope you enjoy the new translations!

Finally, designing and developing all the content in Content Patch #9 took [i]quite[/i] a bit of time and effort. For that reason, Content Patch #10 will be released in 4 weeks and will primarily focus on adding more Quality of Life features. I will be spending most of this time resting and recovering, so please don't expect anything as crazy as this Content Patch in Content Patch #10.

I'm so happy I finally get to share this new content with all of you. This really is my dream job and I enjoy every minute of it. Thank you for believing in Luck be a Landlord enough to buy it while it's in Early Access. I couldn't add this much content to the game if not for your support, so thank you.

I'm going to go pass out now.

-Dan

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Watermelons now give 1 additional coin for each other Watermelon
[*] Duds are now destroyed after 33 spins
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

Watermelons were slightly underpowered for a Very Rare symbol. However, I wanted to be careful with how much I buffed the symbol, as some of the new Essences indirectly buff Watermelon's potential.

Duds were reworked as they were discouraging players who wished to play primarily in Endless Mode. The hoops one has to jump through to remove Duds at the apartment floors in which they appear made it so that "Endless-only" players would only play on floor 4 or lower. This change will hopefully encourage "Endless-only" players to try out the higher apartment floors, as they should have an easier time transitioning into a more enjoyable Endless Mode.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

notes.title: Content Patch #8 -- New Soundtrack
notes.content:
The game has been patched to add new music, features, and bug fixes!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Modified 1 existing symbol (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Modified 6 existing items (changes listed under Game Balance)
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[*] Added 8 new songs to the game's soundtrack
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Brazilian-Portuguese localization
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Spain-Spanish localization
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's LatAm-Spanish localization
[*] Re-translated and improved the game's Traditional Chinese localization
[*] Added an option for switching between the New Soundtrack, Old Soundtrack, or Both Soundtracks
[*] Added a hotkey command for using Removal Tokens (X by default)
[*] Added a hotkey command for using Reroll Tokens (R by default)
[*] Made it so that the same hotkey can be bound to multiple commands
[*] Made the music volume not decrease when paying rent
[*] Made the music change every 4 rent payments (instead of every 3 rent payments)
[*] Updated the Credits Menu to reflect the hard work of the Localization and Music Team
[/list]

[h1]News[/h1]

Hey everyone!

The Music Team (which is really just one person) added some incredible songs to the game's soundtrack, they did an incredible job keeping the game's original music-feel (that's a word, right? there's a reason I hired someone else to do music stuff) and I can't wait for you to hear their work.

The Localization Team has been hard at work to re-localize the game into the languages it was initially translated into, since the initial translation service I used was full of inconsistencies and typos. Their hard work has resulted in this Content Patch having [b]a lot[/b] of re-localized strings. While the Localization Team is almost full, I'm still looking to add folks who can localize and re-localize the game in Simplified Chinese, Italian, Russian, and Japanese. Feel free to send me an email if you'd like to apply for the position!

Also, while this Content Patch doesn't feature any new Symbols or Items, please know that I've been hard at work doing quite a bit of designing for Content Patch #9. Game development is a weird thing and the new mode that I've been teasing has sort of morphed into something very different, but very cool, which required a lot of re-design. I can't wait to show it to you all once Content Patch #9 is ready.

I'm also very happy with the current state of the game's balance, so there weren't a ton of gameplay changes to Symbols or Items. That having been said, I'd like to re-iterate that if you're hungry for new Content, you'll likely be very satisfied with Content Patch #9.

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] 5th Ace is now Common (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Birdhouse is now Common (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Black Cat now gives 6 coins (instead of 3 coins) whenever you gain a multiple of 13 after spinning
[*] Chicken Coop now makes Eggs, Chicks, Chickens, and Golden Eggs give 2 additional coins (instead of 1 additional coin)
[*] Rain Cloud is now Common (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Watering Can now has the additional effect of "Seeds give 5 coins more"
[*] Anchor's description was re-written to specify it gives a total of 5 coins (this doesn't change it gameplay-wise)
[*] Bees now give a 2x multiplier to adjacent Beehives and Honey (in addition to flowers)
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

5th Ace, Birdhouse, and Rain Cloud were changed to Common from Uncommon both due to their power-level both being lower than that of the average Uncommon, and for being too difficult obtain to be build-enablers

The changes to Black Cat were made to make the item's hard-to-achieve effect have slightly more upside.

Chicken Coop was a bit lacking for a Rare item, so the coin-granting effect was buffed

Watering Can was given its additional effect to, effectively, make seeds give a one-time coin bonus, further increasing their potential value

Bee was almost never a beneficial symbol except for very early stages of the game, so having it buff more symbols will hopefully make the symbol more useful in in the early to mid-game

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

notes.content:
I've written before about Luck Be A Landlord, a deck-building roguelikelike where you create a fruit machine that'll hopefully pay your ever-increasing rent. notes.title: Content Patch #7 -- Quality of Life
notes.content:
The game has been patched to add new symbols, items, features, and bug fixes!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new symbols (1 Common, 1 Uncommon, 2 Rare)
[*] Added 2 new items (2 Common)
[*] Modified 6 existing symbols (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Modified 9 existing items (changes listed under Game Balance)
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[*] Added rebindable hotkey options (Controller remapping is currently displayed under this menu, but Controller support is not yet in the game and will be added at a later date)
[*] Added a "Fast-Forward" button (F)
[*] Added a "Lock Tooltip" button (L)
[*] Added an option to change the Spin Speed
[*] Added an option to change the Animation Speed
[*] Added an option to have the game respond when buttons are pressed and released (instead of immediately when they're pressed)
[*] Added a "Reset to Default" button on each options menu
[*] The Apartment Floors now only appear after the Floor 2 is unlocked
[/list]

[h1]News[/h1]

Hey everyone!

The roadmap for this Content Patch and the next has changed slightly. Previously a large amount of time and effort was devoted to adding a new mode to the game (which I teased slightly in previous hotfixes and in the game's [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]discord[/url]). Unfortunately, this mode won't be ready in time for Content Patch #7 or Content Patch #8. My apologies.

On the bright side, this Content Patch contains many Quality of Life features that have been requested for many months. A good amount of QoL features were being worked on, but weren't completed in time for this update. Those features will be added in Content Patch #8, and further QoL updates will be the primary focus of that update.

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Empty symbols can no longer appear on-screen if a non-empty symbol could appear in its place
[*] Players start with 20 empty symbols instead of 25
[*] Ancient Lizard Blade now gives an additional coin
[*] Holy Water now makes Hexes give an additional coin
[*] Lint Roller now gives 10 coin per removed Rabbit Fluff (instead of 6 coins)
[*] Red Pepper now gives 5 coins when its effect is triggered (instead of 3 coins)
[*] Shattered Mirror now gives 24 coins every 7 spins (instead of 20 coins)
[*] Time Machine now makes Golems be destroyed in 2 less spins
[*] Time Machine now also makes Frozen Fossils be destroyed in 5 less spins
[*] Void Portal now gives 1 coin for every 8 symbols destroyed in a game (instead of for every 10 symbols)
[*] Zaroff's Contract now makes Bounty Hunters give 20 coins per symbol destroyed (instead of 15 coins)
[*] Beehive can no longer add Bees and has a 10% chance of adding Honey (instead of a 5% chance)
[*] Billionaires no longer add Spirits when destroyed if the player has a Shrine item
[*] Bounty Hunters now give 20 coins for each Thief destroyed (instead of 10 coins)
[*] Dwarves now give coins equal to 10x the value of destroyed Ores and Big Ores (if the player has Dwarven Anvil)
[*] Eldritch Creatures are now buffed by Beastmasters
[*] Magic Key now has a base value of 2 coins (instead of 1 coin) and makes symbols it destroys give 3x more coins (instead of 2x more)
[*] Rabbits are now Uncommon (instead of Common) and have the effect of "Permanently gives 2 coins more after giving coins 10 times."
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

The changes to Empty symbols effectively make it so that if there is "room" for an off-screen non-Empty symbol to appear where an Empty symbol could, the game will make it so that the non-Empty always appears on-screen. This will not only reduce frustration, it will make counting out Empty symbols in the inventory easier, make it harder to lose in the early stages of the game, and reduce unfun randomness.

Ancient Lizard Blade has been tweaked again to provide the power one would expect from a Very Rare item.

Holy Water makes Hexes give an additional coin in order to make the item more in-line with a Rare item, as well as provide an additional incentive to be added to one's inventory if a player doesn't want to disable the effects of Hexes.

The changes to Rabbits and the Lint Roller item are in order to make builds with Rabbits more viable. Making Rabbit an Uncommon symbol also makes it synergize more effectively with the Lucky Carrot and Golden Carrot items (as it was previously difficult to find Rabbits after acquiring one of these items, due to its Common rarity).

Red Pepper has had its trigger value increased in order to make its (hard to achieve) effect more rewarding.

Shattered Mirror has had its trigger value increased in order to make the item's average "coins per spin" more powerful than the Bowling Ball item (as now it's effectively a more powerful Bowling Ball with a downside).

Time Machine affecting Golem and Frozen Fossil was primarily added since many players expecting these symbols and items to synergize anyway. Adding this effect barely effects game balance, but means players will spend less time trying to remember things like "Wait, does Time Machine affect Golems?" This logic is also the reasoning behind the Dwarven Anvil change.

Void Portal, while still very powerful at late stages of a game, was a bit lackluster for a Rare item when player would initially add it to their inventory. For this reason, the item has been buffed to increase its "early-game" potential.

The changes to Zaroff's Contract and Bounty Hunters are to make Bounty Hunter-heavy builds a more viable strategy.

Beehive no longer produces Bees as Bees were almost always a detriment to players when they were added during a spin. The chance of adding Honey was been doubled in order to further increase the potential of the symbol.

Billionaires no longer drop Spirits when the player has the Shrine item because they don't have souls.

The changes to Eldritch Creatures was primarily for the same reasons as the Time Machine changes (bringing symbol synergies in-line with what players expect). However, these changes are more likely to affect gameplay substantially if the player can achieve the new synergy.

Magic Key has had its value and multiplier increased to make the symbol less detrimental if the player adds it to their inventory and has a "drought" of Lockboxes, Safes, etc.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

[list]
[*] Modified the logic of symbols being destroyed (more details below)
[*] Modified the logic of symbols being added during a spin (more details below)
[/list]

The symbol destruction logic will, honestly, barely be noticeable to many players. For this reason, I won't go into details of [i]exactly[/i] what's going on "under the hood." However, many interactions involving symbol destruction have been made much more consistent. A number of the most reported issues have been listed under the Bug Fixes section.

The symbol addition logic will likely be more noticeable to players. Symbols that are added during a spin are now only added once every symbol has no more possible effects it can execute. For example, if a Monkey is adjacent to two Coconuts, the Coconut Halves from the first Coconut destruction will only be added [b]after[/b] the second Coconut is destroyed (and any other symbol effects are done executing). This logic modification was done to help fix numerous bugs, and make less situations where players will be confused by how symbols interact with each other. While the new logic may take some time to get used to, I feel that the improved interaction consistency will definitely be worth it in the long run.

As this hotfix vastly modifies existing engine logic (which hasn't been touched in a while), it's likely that some new bugs may arise from this hotfix.

If you find any bugs, make sure to file a report in the #bug-reports channel of the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

The game has been patched to add new symbols, items, and bug fixes!

[h1]News[/h1]

As announced in the patch notes for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404850/view/3016823329564341798]previous Content Patch[/url], I took a good chunk of time to re-assess the game's roadmap during the development of this Content Patch. Over the course of this re-assessment, I determined Content Patch #7 will take 4 weeks to complete. However, I'm [i]very[/i] excited for the new features that will be added in that patch, which I think will be worth the wait. Thank you for your patience!

In other news, Rare and Very Rare symbols/items will no longer have their names [spoiler]censored[/spoiler] in these patch notes. However, any references to symbols/items that are new as of this Content Patch will have their names [spoiler]censored[/spoiler] to prevent players from being spoiled, if they so wish.

It has also been brought to my attention that the localization of the game in languages other than English, German, and Danish (the languages handled by myself and a few individuals that I trust) is very -- for lack of a better term -- bad. I am doing my best to find and hire new translators for the languages the game is currently translated in and will have more news about this in the future. In the meantime, please accept my personal apology for the poor quality translations that the game currently has in those languages, and know that the game's localization will be gradually updated over time.

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] 5th Ace is now Uncommon (instead of Rare)
[*] Ancient Lizard Blade now gives an additional coin and does not take Empty symbols into account
[*] Gray Pepper now gives 6 coins when Removal Tokens are spent (instead of 3 coins)
[*] Lint Roller now gives 6 coins when it removes Rabbit Fluff (instead of 3 coins)
[*] Reworked Mining Pick to have the effect of "Gives 5 coins whenever Ore or Big Ore are destroyed." (instead of its previous effect)
[*] Ninja and Mouse now gives a 5x multiplier (instead of a 4x multiplier)
[*] Protractor now triggers its effect every 3 spins (instead of every 4 spins)
[*] Red Pepper now gives 3 coins if every symbol is different (instead of 5 coins) and does not take Empty symbols into account
[*] Wanted Poster now gives Thieves a 3x multiplier (instead of a 2x multiplier) when destroyed
[*] Card Shark is now Rare (instead of Very Rare)
[*] Cats now destroy adjacent [spoiler]Milk[/spoiler] and give 9 coins for each [spoiler]Milk[/spoiler] they destroy
[*] Chefs have realized they can probably use Chemical Seven as a pretty cool sauce, so it can now receive a multiplier from adjacent Chefs and appear from a destroyed Lunchbox
[*] Farmer now gives a 2x multiplier to adjacent Seeds, Eggs, Chicks, Chickens, Golden Eggs, [spoiler]Cows[/spoiler], and [spoiler]Milk[/spoiler] (in addition to the symbols he gave a multiplier to previously)
[*] General Zaroff now gives 20 coins for each symbol destroyed (instead of 15 coins)
[*] Joker now has a base value of 3 coins (instead of 2 coins)
[*] Robin Hood now makes adjacent Thieves and Arrows give an extra 3 coins (in addition to his previous effects)
[*] Robin Hood also now destroys adjacent Targets, Apples, and [spoiler]Billionaires[/spoiler] and gives 15 coins for each symbol he destroys (in addition to his previous effects)
[*] Reworked Thief to have the effect of "Gives ? coins when destroyed. '?' increases by 4 coins each spin." (instead of their previous effect) (for clarity, they still take 1 coin each spin)
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

5th Ace has had its rarity reduced since ts effect, while potentially very powerful, can be quite inconsistent. Reducing its rarity will make the item appear in more situations where the player may have a Suit-heavy inventory. The same logic is why Card Shark has his rarity changed.

Ancient Lizard Blade was slightly buffed to make it more powerful in more scenarios, as it wasn't very hard for it have the power level of an Uncommon item (or worse) in many scenarios.

The average amount of coins Gray Pepper and Lint Roller gave over the course of a run was miniscule. Doubling the amount of coins they give should help to make up for this.

Mining Pick could actually be detrimental if received from an Item Capsule or Mine when the player is trying to destroy Ores with Geologists and/or Miners. To account for this, the new effect lets players get further ahead if they already have an Ore-heavy inventory.

Ninja and Mouse has had its multiplier effect slightly increased to account for the large variety of symbols that can be obtained over the course of a run (something I'm keeping a close eye on and have plans for)

Protractor's effect wasn't happening frequently enough to be powerful enough for a Rare item, hence the buff. This will also mitigate the (extremely rare) scenario where a Protractor would have no effect as it was always triggering on the same turn as a Telescope.

Red Pepper's effect was extremely hard to pull off as it took Empty symbols into account. Now that the item ignores Empty symbols, the coins given has also been reduced to keep the item balanced.

Wanted Poster was buffed to more frequently give players more of a reward when they are able to destroy a Thief (as achieving this can still be somewhat difficult in the current iteration of the game).

Cats now being able to destroy a [spoiler]Milk[/spoiler] and give coins for it will add some more early-game survivability to most runs. This is especially true as [spoiler]Milk[/spoiler] is a Common symbol, and each player starts with a Cat.

Chemical Seven being considered a food is mostly for consistency reasons, but also can make an early Lunchbox item more powerful on average.

Farmers giving multipliers to more symbols is also mostly for consistency reasons (meaning symbols will synergize with what players expect them to synergize with).

General Zaroff has been buffed as adding him to one's inventory can prevent players from benefitting from the effects of many of the Rare symbols that he destroys.

Joker giving an additional coin each spin is primarily so that it can be more of a "build-enabler" without a setback of a low base value.

Robin Hood's new effects are also mostly for consistency reasons. However these changes can make Robin Hood provide quite a bit of extra utility if the player decides to add him to their inventory, especially if they find one of the seven symbols he now synergizes with.

The reworking of Thief makes the symbol functionally the same in a vacuum. However, it will now still have its counter increase if the player has Anthropology Degree or Tax Evasion. This was an interaction that, while intentional, many players complained to me about. Because of this, I've reworked the logic so this interaction won't happen anymore.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

notes.title: Content Patch #5 -- Apartment Floors
notes.content:
The game has been patched to add new symbols, items, features and bug fixes!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added apartment floors, with each unlocked apartment floor (up to the 9th floor currently), you have the option of making the game more challenging (you select your floor at the start of a new run)
[*] Added 3 new symbols (1 Common, 2 Uncommon)
[*] Added 4 new items (1 Common, 1 Uncommon, 2 Rare)
[*] Modified 3 existing symbols (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Modified 1 existing item (changes listed under Game Balance)
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] The removed symbols are now listed in the inventory
[*] Added an option for 144FPS
[*] Content Patch #6 will release in 3 weeks (instead of 2 weeks) in order to provide extra time so Dan (that's me!) can re-assess the game's roadmap
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Decreased the cost of the 7th, 8th, 10th, and 11th rent payment by 25 coins
[*] Increased the cost of the 6th rent payment by 25 coins
[*] Increased the amount of Removal Tokens given per email by 1
[*] Reworked [spoiler]Ancient Lizard Blade[/spoiler] to have the effect of "Gives 6 coins each spin. Gives 1 coin less for each symbol in your inventory with a quantity of 2 or more. Cannot give less than 0 coins." (instead of its previous effect)
[*] [spoiler]Bartender[/spoiler] now has a 10% chance of adding a symbol (instead of 5%)
[*] Hex of Thievery has had its wording clarified to note that it has a 30% chance of taking 6 coins (this does not change how it functions gameplay-wise)
[*] Miner now gives 10 coins for each symbol it destroys
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

A large amount of players felt the game had become too challenging with Content Patch #4. While many other players (myself included) enjoyed the challenge that comes with higher rent payments and less removal tokens, forcing this difficulty on [i]every[/i] player makes the game less enjoyable overall. For this reason I've made the "base-game" more in-line with the difficulty level of previous patches, and have moved much of the difficulty to the new apartment floors. If you'd like to challenge yourself in the game, I'd recommend giving the new system a try!

[spoiler]Ancient Lizard Blade[/spoiler]'s previous effect could be more of a hindrance than a benefit in almost all situations. This new effect is still on-theme and is closer to what one expects for a "Very Rare" item.

While [spoiler]Bartender[/spoiler] was already a very good symbol power-wise, the frequency at which symbols would be added was low enough that the effect was uninteresting and felt almost "tacked-on." The odds of a symbol being added have been slightly increased to make runs more interesting, while not breaking the game's balance.

Many players were completely ignoring Miners and hoping to just get a Mining Pick or [spoiler]Geologist[/spoiler] to break their Ores. Miners giving coins on symbol destruction will hopefully make them more viable in the "early-game."

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

notes.title: Content Patch #4 -- More Languages
notes.content:
The game has been patched to add localization support, as well as balance changes.

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added language support for Latin American Spanish.
[*] Added language support for Polish.
[*] Added language support for Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).
[*] Added language support for Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong).
[*] Added language support for Japanese.
[*] Added language support for Korean.
[*] Modified 11 existing symbols (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Modified 7 existing items (changes listed under Game Balance)
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the cost of the 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, and 11th rent payment by 25 coins
[*] The emails providing Reroll Tokens and Removal Tokens now give an additional Reroll Token, but only appear every other rent payment (starting from the 3rd rent payment)
[*] Clear Sky is now Rare (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Looting Glove now grants its 1.5x multiplier to Thieves, Void Creatures, and Void Stones when they are destroyed (in addition to the symbols it previously affected)
[*] Maxwell the Bear now gives Bears a 1.5x bonus multiplier (instead of 2x)
[*] Ninja and Mouse now clarifies that its effect can only be applied once each spin (this doesn't change the gameplay functionality)
[*] Quigley the Wolf no longer makes Wolves Common
[*] Rusty Gear is now Uncommon instead of Common
[*] The [spoiler]Archaeologist[/spoiler] looked up what the definition of "archaeology" is and realized he's more of a [spoiler]Geologist[/spoiler] and will be referred to as such from now on
[*] Bears are now Uncommon (instead of Common) and give 2 coins (instead of 1)
[*] Bees are now Common (instead of Uncommon)
[*] It was discovered that Chemical Seven actually contains alcohol, so the [spoiler]Bartender[/spoiler] will now serve it and Happy Hour will affect it
[*] Clubs, Hearts, Diamonds, and Spades now give an additional coin if there are at least 3 Clubs, Hearts, Diamonds, or Spades
[*] Cultists now give 0 coins (instead of 1 coin) and give an additional coin if there are at least 4 Cultists (their previous effect of giving 1 more coin for each other Cultist has not been changed)
[*] Hustling Capsules now take an additional coin
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

The large increase in rent payment requirements and decrease in Reroll/Removal token frequency is due to it currently being too easy to get to the final rent payment.

Clear Sky and Rusty Gear having their rarities increased is due to them being much more powerful when compared to other items in their same rarity slots.

Looting Glove now affects more symbols for logical reasons, and to give it some more utility.

Maxwell the Bear now gives less of a multiplier to Bears as Bears now give more coins, due to them being Uncommon.

Quigley the Wolf was found to be far too powerful at his current level for a Common item, so his effects have been dialed back a bit.

Bees are now Common as their power level is more in line with what one would expect from a Common symbol.

The Suits symbols were given a new effect to encourage more players to take them and also bring their power level a bit closer to where it makes sense for an Uncommon symbol to be.

In the first rent payment or two, it was almost never incorrect to take a Cultist, nerfing them slightly is to create more situations where one has to decide if they really want to do a "Cultist build."

Hustling Capsules are still quite strong for an Uncommon symbol, so they've been nerfed again slightly.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

[*] The 3rd starting symbol is now a Pearl (instead of a random Suit symbol)
[*] Removed Light Bulb, Topaz, Copper, and Bluebird from the game
[*] [spoiler]Ancient Lizard Blade[/spoiler] now gives 5 coins if every symbol is different
[*] Black Cat now gives 3 coins if a multiple of 13 is gained after a spin (instead of giving 13 coins if exactly 13 coins is gained after a spin) and gives Cats a 2x multiplier (instead of 3x)
[*] [spoiler]Booster Pack[/spoiler] now gives an additional Common symbol and an additional Uncommon symbol
[*] [spoiler]Chicken Coop[/spoiler] is now Rare (instead of Uncommon) and makes Eggs, Chicks, [spoiler]Chickens[/spoiler], and [spoiler]Golden Eggs[/spoiler] give 1 more coin
[*] Coin on a String is now Uncommon (instead of Common) and has been reworked to have the effect of "Gives 1 coin. Removes all Coin symbols before each spin. Gives 3 coins whenever Coin symbols are removed."
[*] Comfy Pillow now makes 1 item Rare or better (instead of 2 items)
[*] Cursed Katana is now Uncommon (instead of Rare)
[*] Fish Bowl is now a Fish Tank to encourage taking better care of the fish (it also has a water filter)
[*] Ninja and Mouse now gives a 4x multiplier (instead of a 5x multiplier)
[*] Nori the Rabbit is now Common (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Piggy Bank is now Uncommon (instead of Common) and puts 2 coins in itself each spin (instead of 1 coin)
[*] [spoiler]Protractor[/spoiler] now only has an effect every 4 spins
[*] Quigley the Wolf is now Common (instead of Uncommon)
[*] [spoiler]Recycling[/spoiler] is now Rare (instead of Very Rare) and has been reworked to have the effect of "Gives 1 [spoiler]Reroll Token[/spoiler] each spin."
[*] Shattered Mirror now gives 20 coins every 7 spins (instead of 7 coins every 3 spins)
[*] Shedding Season is now Common (instead of Uncommon) and gives Rabbits a 10% chance of adding Rabbit Fluff (instead of 20%)
[*] Swear Jar now has a 30 coins threshold (instead of 25 coins)
[*] [spoiler]Telescope[/spoiler] now only has an effect every 4 spins
[*] Time Machine now also makes Matryoshka Dolls take 2 less turns to be destroyed
[*] Zaroff's Contract is now Uncommon (instead of Rare)
[*] [spoiler]Archaeologist[/spoiler] now destroys Sapphires
[*] Clubs and Spades now only apply their adjacency effect to Clubs and Spades (instead of Diamonds and Hearts as well)
[*] Diamonds and Hearts now only apply their adjacency effect to Diamonds and Hearts (instead of Clubs and Spades as well)
[*] [spoiler]Diver[/spoiler] now removes symbols (instead of destroying them) and additionally removes Snails
[*] Matryoshka Doll now takes 1 less turn to be destroyed at each stage
[*] [spoiler]Joker[/spoiler] now gives 2 coins (instead of 3) and gives Suits a 2x multiplier (instead of 3x)
[*] [spoiler]Mrs. Fruit[/spoiler] figured out that the inside of a Coconut tastes good too and now destroys Coconut Halves
[*] [spoiler]Witch[/spoiler] now also applies a 2x multiplier to Owls and Apples
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

The large increase in rent payment requirements is due to the new currencies making the game easier overall.

The change to the 3rd starting symbol as well as the changes to Suit symbols and [spoiler]Joker[/spoiler] is to make players have to commit harder if they wish to do a "Suits build."

The removal of Light Bulb, Topaz, Copper, and Bluebird is to make it easier for players to get the symbols they're looking for at the Common and Uncommon rarity.

[spoiler]Ancient Lizard Blade[/spoiler] was given the "Red Pepper Effect" to create a bit more of a payoff if the player takes the item and uses it to their advantage.

Black Cat had its first effect reworked as it was close to impossible to benefit from it in its current state. Its second effect was to make "Cat builds" slightly more in-line with other "builds" that take minimal risk to achieve.

[spoiler]Booster Pack[/spoiler] now gives a few additional symbols so that it can be more in-line with other Rare items.

[spoiler]Chicken Coop[/spoiler] causing Egg-related symbols to give more coins is to give players more of a reward if they gain a large number of Eggs, which is quite easy to do with the existing Chicken Coop item. The item was upshifted to Rare to better match its power level.

Coin on a String and Piggy Bank were changed to prevent them from effectively being "strictly worse Pool Balls"

Comfy Pillow was modified to be a bit less powerful as the reward from skipping a rent payment was too great when compared to the risk.

Cursed Katana had its rarity downshifted as it was close to impossible to benefit from the reduced rarity of Ninjas at the point in the game when a Rare item could frequently be obtained.

Ninja and Mouse had its multiplier slightly decreased as the new currency -- which allows players to easily remove symbols -- made it much easier to achieve a "Ninja and Mouse build."

Nori the Rabbit, Quigley the Wolf, and Zaroff's Contract had their rarities downshifted to better match their power level at this point in the game's development.

[spoiler]Protractor[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Telescope[/spoiler] now only "activate" every 4 spins to reduce their (incredibly high) power level, while still retaining the fun effect of bypassing adjacency restrictions, just less frequently than before.

[spoiler]Recycling[/spoiler] was reworked to highlight the new currency added in this patch, as well as to reduce its power level as it could be previously used to get close to [i]exactly[/i] the symbols one wanted over the course of the game.

Shattered Mirror was modified to increase amount of coins it gives on average.

Shedding Season was downshifted in rarity to make Rabbits a more viable early-game symbol. The chance of Rabbits adding Rabbit Fluff was reduced by 10% to better reflect the new rarity.

Swear Jar had its threshold modified to increase its viability mid-game.

Time Machine effecting Matryoshka Dolls is to make the item more viable overall, as most players only had a reason to take it if they already had a Coal symbol.

The additional symbols that can be destroyed/removed by [spoiler]Archaeologist[/spoiler], [spoiler]Mrs. Fruit[/spoiler], and [spoiler]Diver[/spoiler] are to improve the consistency of what players expect them to be able to do.

[spoiler]Diver[/spoiler] now removing symbols instead of destroying them is to better fit the game's tenet of not having effects that directly destroy animals (because they're cute).

Matryoshka Dolls taking less turns at each stage is to increase their power level when compared to its Common counterpart: Coal.

[spoiler]Witch[/spoiler] now applying a multiplier to Owls and Apples is mostly for flavor reasons, but more synergies never hurt!

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

notes.title: Content Patch #2 -- Endless Mode
notes.content:
The game has been patched to add new symbols, items, features, and bug fixes!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an [b]Endless Mode[/b], where the Rent will endlessly increase, how long can you last without getting evicted? (the game mode can be changed into "Endless" after making the 12th rent payment)
[*] Added 7 new symbols (1 Common, 2 Uncommon, 3 Rare, 1 Very Rare)
[*] Added 9 new items (3 Common, 3 Uncommon, 3 Rare)
[*] Modified 15 existing symbols (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Modified 6 existing items (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Removed 5 existing symbols (changes listed under Game Balance)
[*] Removed 2 existing items (changes listed under Game Balance)
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] The total rent payments and remaining rent payments are now displayed on the inventory screen
[*] Buttons in pop-ups from items such as [spoiler]Swapping Device[/spoiler] now have a 1 second delay before they are clickable in order to prevent misclicks
[*] The "close inventory" button now appears in the top-right corner of the inventory (instead of at the bottom)
[*] Similar animations can now happen at the same time (this does not apply to every animation, but more instances of this feature will be added over time)
[*] Reduced the number of clicks necessary for using [spoiler]Swapping Device[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced the cost of the 4th, 7th, and 8th rent payment by 25 coins
[*] Increased the cost of the 9th, 10th, and 11th rent payment by 50 coins
[*] Increased the cost of the 12th rent payment by 27 coins
[*] Reduced the number of spins between the 11th and 12th rent payment by 1
[*] The 3rd starting symbol is now either Clubs or Diamonds, chosen randomly (as opposed to always being Spades)
[*] Removed Pear, Pigeon, Quartz, Penguin, and Amethyst from the game
[*] Removed Pitchfork and Proliferation from the game
[*] Black Suits and Red Suits are now Uncommon items (instead of Common)
[*] Checkered Flag is now a Common item (instead of Uncommon)
[*] Ninja and Mouse now gives a 5x multiplier (instead of a 10x multiplier)
[*] [spoiler]Recycling[/spoiler] now costs 6 coins to use (instead of 3)
[*] Watering Can now makes Seeds 100% more likely to grow (instead of 50%)
[*] Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, and Spades now make adjacent Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, and Spades give 1 more coin
[*] Hearts and Spades are now Uncommon (instead of Common)
[*] Coconut is now Uncommon (instead of Common)
[*] Crabs now give 3 more coins for each other Crab in the same row (instead of 2)
[*] [spoiler]Witches[/spoiler] now give adjacent Crows a 2x multiplier
[*] Dwarves now give 10x the value of symbols they destroy (instead of 7x)
[*] Hustling Capsules now give -6 coins (instead of -4)
[*] Light Bulbs now have a 50% chance of giving adjacent Flowers a 2x multipliers and making adjacent Seeds grow (instead of 20%)
[*] Monkeys now give 5x the value of symbols they destroy (instead of 7x)
[*] [spoiler]Mrs. Fruit[/spoiler] can now also destroy adjacent Oranges, Peaches, and Plums
[*] Owls now give an additional 1 coin every 3 spins
[*] Rain now makes adjacent Seeds 50% more likely to grow (instead of 30%)
[*] Seeds now give 1 coin
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

The changes to the rent payment values were made in order to make the "early-game" easier while making the "late-game" harder, as many players were either losing by the 4th rent payment, or making it to the final rent payment.

The random Clubs or Diamonds in the opening symbols is to create more variety and make the Red Suits Item not inherently worse than then Black Suits item (since players previously started with Spades, which Black Suits synergizes with, but not Red Suits).

The removal of some symbols was done to reduce the total number of symbols in the "symbol pool." This will make it easier for players to get more beneficial symbols, as opposed to deciding between 3 copies of the same symbol mechanics-wise (which could happen before). The symbols chosen to be removed from the game are ones that are functionally the same in many situations, such as Pear being functionally the same as Cherry.

The removal of Pitchfork and Proliferation was done since they are mechanically very similar to Watering Can theme-wise, and objectively worse than the newly-buffed Watering Can mechanics-wise.

Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, and Spades were given their new effect in order to make "Suits builds" more viable. However, Hearts and Spades were made Uncommon as having 4 Common symbols that all 
exponentially synergized with each other was found to be too powerful in testing. These buffs are also why Black Suits and Red Suits are now Uncommon items instead of Common.

Checkered Flag was made a Common item to increase the viability of symbols that give additional coins every few spins, such as Snail, Turtle, Sloth, Magpie, [spoiler]Robin Hood[/spoiler], and now Owl.

Ninja and Mouse had its effect halved as it was one of the easiest ways to win the game. This decrease in power should still keep it as a useful Common item, while stopping it from frequently being an "auto-win" item.

[spoiler]Recycling[/spoiler] has had its effect cost increased to 6 coins from 3 in order to make players commit further if they wish to reroll many times to get specific symbols. It should still be a very powerful item, but now with a bit more of a caveat.

Watering Can was buffed to make Seeds guaranteed to grow in order to further make "Seed/Plant builds" more viable. The same reasoning is why Seeds now give 1 coin instead of 0 coins, and why Light Bulbs and Rain have been buffed.

The Monkey nerfs (7x to 5x) are due to their ability to generate very large amounts of coins early in the game. This is also why Coconut was made an Uncommon symbol instead of a Common symbol.

Crabs now give an extra coin for each other Crab in the same row to increase their viability when compared to other similar symbols such as Cultists.

[spoiler]Witches[/spoiler] giving adjacent Crows a 2x multiplier is mainly for flavor reasons, but it also increases the viability of the two symbols.

Dwarves now give 10x the value of each symbol they destroy as they were found to be a bit lacking when compared to other symbol-destroying symbols, such as Toddlers and Monkeys.

Hustling Capsules now takes 2 more coins to make them a bit less powerful when compared to the effect they give when destroyed.

[spoiler]Mrs. Fruit[/spoiler]'s ability to destroy Uncommon fruit was added to make her synergize better with Compost Heap, and increase her utility when compared to her husband: [spoiler]Archaeologist[/spoiler].

Owls now give an additional 1 coin every 3 spins in order to increase their "early-game" viability. This is, honestly, more of a band-aid fix for the time being as I assess ways to make niche symbols like Owl more viable.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a logging system for improved bug reporting, please upload your log files when reporting bugs from now on in the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url] (a new log file is created whenever a new run of Luck be a Landlord starts, the log file directory can be opened by pressing [b]F8[/b] while in-game)
[*] Destroyed Symbols and Items are now displayed on the Inventory screen
[*] The total number of Symbols and Items are now displayed on the Inventory screen
[*] The Options menu now has a back button that will go back to the previous screen (rather than closing the entire menu)
[*] The Danish translator's Twitter page is now linked to under Options/Credits
[*] Added an option under Options/Audio that will mute the game if the window is unfocused
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Compost Heap is now Uncommon (instead of Common) and has the additional effect of "Seeds will only grow into Uncommon or better symbols."
[*] Purple Pepper now gives 5 coins when its requirements are met (instead of 3)
[*] Red Pepper now gives 5 coins when its requirements are met (instead of 3)
[*] Yellow Pepper now gives 2 coins when its requirements are met (instead of 3)
[*] Banana Peels now destroy themselves after destroying Thieves
[*] Bounty Hunters now give an additional 10 coins whenever they destroy a Thief
[*] Thieves now give 4x the coins they've stolen when destroyed (instead of 3x) and steal even if they are destroyed in the same spin
[*] Monkeys now give 7x the value of symbols they destroy (instead of a flat 15 coins) and destroy two new symbols: [spoiler]Coconut[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Coconut Half[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Midas Bomb[/spoiler] now makes symbols it destroys give 7x more coins (instead of 10x more)
[*] Hex of Emptiness' description has been reworded for improved clarity (it's still functionally the same)
[/list]

The above balance changes were made for the following reasons:

Compost Heap would frequently flood a player's inventory with Seeds, which would often have a negative impact on the game. Compost Heap was also the only item that could appear from an Item Capsule with a potentially negative effect on the game. For this reason, the item has been made Uncommon and has had its power level made more in line with other Uncommon Items.

Purple Pepper and Red Pepper are currently the two pepper items with the most difficult requirements to achieve. For this reason, the amount of coins they give when their requirements are met has been increased. The inverse is true for Yellow Pepper.

The changes to Banana Peels, Bounty Hunters, and Thieves were made to make Thief a more viable symbol overall.

[spoiler]Midas Bomb[/spoiler] now gives a 7x multiplier (instead of 10x) to bring down its power level slightly, while still keeping it one of the most powerful symbols.

Hex of Emptiness' description was changed as many players were confused as to what it actually did (before adding the symbol and seeing it in action).

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the buttons that appear when a player has more than 16 items would not function correctly after reloading the game
[*] Fixed a bug where only Common symbols and items could appear when reloading the game under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed a bug where the buttons to destroy items like Piggy Bank would disappear when reloading the game under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed a bug where the text prompt from [spoiler]Swapping Device[/spoiler] would not be displayed properly while playing in Russian or Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Fixed a bug where symbols wouldn't have their multiplier bonuses applied correctly under certain circumstances
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Hotfix #3
notes.content:
The game has been patched with bug fixes and balance changes.

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lockpick now has a 30% of destroying symbols (up from 20%)
[*] Checkered Flag now also affects [spoiler]Robin Hood[/spoiler] and Magpie
[*] Shedding Season is now Uncommon instead of Common
[*] Recycling is now Rare instead of Uncommon
[/list]

The above balance changes were made to reduce the frequency of run-winning combos appearing very early on in a run, as well as to slightly buff a few symbols and items.

I noticed through playtesting that players would often lose a run due to a Lockbox or Safe not being destroyed just before a rent payment. Buffing Lockpick should help to alleviate that.

Checkered Flag was modified in order to make [spoiler]Robin Hood[/spoiler] and Magpie slightly more powerful overall, as many players seemed to avoid picking these symbols due to them taking coins more often than not.

In regards to Shedding Season and Recycling having their rarity changed, this is due to them being incredibly powerful when obtained early on in a run. My design philosophy is to not take away fun "game-breaking" combos unless it is absolutely 100% necessary for the health and balance of the game. I did not feel this was necessary with these items, so I have changed the rarities in order to simply make these situations appear less often on average.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Coin on a String wasn't rolling its 10% break chance properly
[*] Fixed a bug where Ores had a 50% chance to not be destroyed when adjacent to a Miner if the player also had the Mining Pick item
[*] Fixed a bug where Miners would sometimes destroy the symbols added from destroying Ores.
[*] Fixed a bug where Eggs could still be made into Omelettes while the player has the Frying Pan item even after transforming into Chicks (gross!)
[*] Fixed a bug introduced in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1404850/view/2953765324049670066]Launch Hotfix #2[/url] where Hex of Thievery couldn't take any coins
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Hotfix #2
notes.content:
The game has been patched with bug fixes, minor balance changes, and a countdown timer.

[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the odds of finding Rare and Very Rare items by 2.5x
[*] The symbol choice after the 1st rent payment is now guaranteed to have 3 Uncommon symbols or better (up from 1 Uncommon symbol or better)
[*] The symbol choice after the 2nd rent payment is now guaranteed to have 3 Uncommon symbols or better (up from 2 Uncommon symbols or better)
[*] Hex of Thievery now follows the same multiplier logic as other symbols, in that it will no longer have multipliers applied (such as the one from a Witch) when the symbol's value is negative
[/list]

The above balance changes were made to make the game somewhat easier overall, as well as increasing viable build variety.

I understand that these changes aren't going to 100% solve the problem that some of you may have had with the randomness of the game, but know that I am listening and am working on solutions to the best of my ability.

I would like to add many more balance changes in the first content update, which will be more substantial than just tweaking a few numbers. Rather than forcing everyone to wait for the content update, I felt that these changes couldn't hurt to add in the meantime.

Please let me know your thoughts either in the comments or on the [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url]!

-Dan

[h1]UI/Graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a timer to the title screen which counts down the time until the game's next content update

[*] Made the Pop-up retain its position when the player rerolls symbols with Recycling
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[*] Fixed a bug where the Options button could be clicked, even when not visible, under certain circumstances

[*] Fixed a bug where [spoiler]Wildcards[/spoiler] would not take the multiplier from Rusty Gear into account
[*] Fixed a bug where Dwarves would give the wrong amount when destroying Beer and Wine while the player had a Lemon
[*] Fixed a bug where a transforming or growing symbol, such as Coal or Seed, would visually change into the end result symbol for 1 frame at the beginning of its animation
[/list]

notes.title: Luck be a Landlord launches in Steam Early Access on January 8th, 2021!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm Dan, the lead (and only) developer behind Luck be a Landlord. I'm happy to announce that the game will be launching in Steam Early Access on January 8th, 2021!

You can watch the release date announcement trailer here:

[previewyoutube=8bOtIvyUvXM;full][/previewyoutube]

Now for a Q&A session that will (hopefully) answer any questions you might have. As always, I'll respond to any questions you leave for me in the game's [url=http://TrampolineTales.com/discord]official discord[/url].

[b]What's new in the Early Access version?[/b]

The Early Access version already has more than double the amount of items and symbols in the demo version! The duration of an average run has also tripled!

[b]What's going to happen to the free demo? Will it still receive updates?[/b]

The demo is unlikely to receive further updates except for bug fixes and quality of life improvements. In other words, any new symbols and items added to the early access version will not be added into the demo.

[b]How much will the Early Access version cost?[/b]

Initially the Early Access version will launch at $9.99 USD (converted into your local currency if you don't use USD, of course), with a 10% discount at launch!

[b]Will the price always be $9.99?[/b]

No. The price of the game will gradually increase as I add more content and features.

[b]How much will the game be when it exits Early Access?[/b]

I am not ready to announce that at this time.

[b]How often will the Early Access version receive updates?[/b]

On average, I would like to release a substantial content/feature update once every 2 to 3 weeks.

Thanks for reading, everyone! I hope you all enjoy the Early Access version of Luck be a Landlord! It's been a blast to develop and I'm just getting started. Until next time...

[i]Luck be a Landlord, tonight![/i]
